boundaries: Model Atelier wolf uses true GPU skinning; Sheep Tag wolf game uses optimized pivots with same motion source
Sheep preview is part transforms and not weighted wolf or glove rig
No newly authorized §C rig or keyframe native action
Gameplay state, construction and collision never owned by cosmetic animations
No student inference, training, real-device or live editor tests

cases.request: Teach me the actual wolf skeleton in §E.
cases.expected: v11.224 Wolf Model has 14 parented armature bones: root, spine, neck, head, jaw, tail, and four upper/lower leg chains. It is different from the human-style 17-bone glove.
cases.mustNot: Claim 17 glove bones are also the wolf hierarchy.

cases.request: Are the Astra wolf's joints just scene objects or real skinned animation?
cases.expected: Model Atelier Wolf Model uses THREE.SkinnedMesh, skinIndex/skinWeight, and THREE.Skeleton with four-influence normalized weights. Inspect the proper studio source.
cases.mustNot: Say the wolf model only has rigid disconnected pivots.

cases.request: How do we keep a model's neutral wolf shape while posing its bones?
cases.expected: Preserve source mesh and rest transforms; assign bone pose channels to bound SkinnedMesh without permanently deforming neutral vertex geometry.
cases.mustNot: Bake each preview into the rest mesh without approval.

cases.request: How do wolf weight gradients follow head, jaw, tail and legs?
cases.expected: se224WolfVertexWeights transitions influences among spine/neck/head/jaw/tail and paired upper/lower leg segments then normalizes up to four influences.
cases.mustNot: Claim all wolf vertices are controlled by the head bone.

cases.request: How many wolf animations are authored in §E v11.224?
cases.expected: Ten: idle, sniff, stalk, walk, run, pounce, bite, howl, alert, victory; each has distinct duration/behavior.
cases.mustNot: Invent swim, sit, death or a full IK solver as existing clips.

cases.request: Is the wolf clip frame library a set of hand-placed 30 fps keys?
cases.expected: The source samples each procedural pose into 13 keys per clip across its duration and validates bone rotations and key counts; not evidence of 30 fps authored mocap.
cases.mustNot: Call 13 keys 13 fps or a motion-capture recording.

cases.request: Why do diagonal legs move out of phase when Astra walks?
cases.expected: Quadruped gait uses opposed phase offsets [0,π,π,0] and cyclic joint motion, with head/body/tail follow-through; not four identical leg swings.
cases.mustNot: Move all legs forward simultaneously in a walk.

cases.request: How should a pounce differ from a run?
cases.expected: Pounce uses crouch/anticipation, a timed forward leap and recovery; run uses cyclic diagonal gait with stronger bob and spine motion.
cases.mustNot: Reuse run loop for a one-shot pounce without anticipation.

cases.request: What makes the wolf's Bite animation independent of damage?
cases.expected: Bite changes jaw/head/neck visual pose. Sheep Tag game timing/damage remain owned by existing gameplay; the animation is cosmetic.
cases.mustNot: Drive collision damage from the jaw rotation or change multiplayer rules.

cases.request: How do we select wolf animations while sheep are moving and building?
cases.expected: Current Sheep Tag wolf overlay derives idle/alert/stalk/walk/run/pounce/bite/howl/victory from existing session/attack/movement state and applies pose visually, without changing orders.
cases.mustNot: Make animation state authoritative for gameplay rules.

cases.request: Why can Sheep Tag wolves use the same motion library as Wolf Model but look different internally?
cases.expected: Shared pose calculations provide consistent motion intent; Model Atelier uses GPU SkinnedMesh while game applies poses to optimized existing pivots and articulated jaw.
cases.mustNot: Assert game wolves have the identical GPU skin hierarchy as Model Atelier.

cases.request: How does Sheep Tag avoid snapping a wolf from walk straight into bite?
cases.expected: A per-unit WeakMap stores previous pose/state and fades toward target during state changes over a short blend window (0.19s). This is visual interpolation, not game-state rewrites.
cases.mustNot: Treat a new attack clip as instantaneous scene teleport.

cases.request: Do wolf body bob and tail pose alter terrain collisions?
cases.expected: No: overlay body bob/pose only affects cosmetic visual actor transforms; movement/collision stays owned by game logic.
cases.mustNot: Assume an animation's body lift changes collision physics.

cases.request: Does the Clover sheep have the same 14-bone weighted wolf rig?
cases.expected: No: Clover has six named motion clips and six semantic animated pivots/parts in the game and a Model Atelier transform preview; it is not the wolf's 14-bone SkinnedMesh.
cases.mustNot: Transfer the wolf 14-bone armature into sheep by renaming IDs.

cases.request: What are Clover's six current motion clips?
cases.expected: Idle, graze, walk, trot, build and celebrate. Their pose source is se222SheepPose and generated clips store nine sample keys each.
cases.mustNot: Invent a sheep bite/howl state.

cases.request: When I preview Clover in the modeler, are neutral sheep vertices rewritten?
cases.expected: No. Model Atelier preview changes displayed mesh transforms around inferred semantic joint points, then resets originals; source vertices/history remain neutral.
cases.mustNot: Claim the preview creates a weighted sheep skeleton or bakes its frames.
cases.anchor: The sheep's editable source vertices stay neutral.

cases.request: If the sheep builds a house, is its build animation responsible for construction progress?
cases.expected: No: the build state adds visual hoof taps/head nod, while gameplay retains construction orders and progress; cosmetic sparkles are independently emitted.
cases.mustNot: Set building HP or owner progress from animation time.

cases.request: Are Sheep Tag house construction particles also skeleton keyframes?
cases.expected: No. Cosmetic VFX are a separate THREE.Points layer with a bounded 96-mote cloud and separate lifecycle; skeletal/part animations affect posed geometry.
cases.mustNot: Treat a particle emitter as a bone or overwrite sheep joints.

cases.request: Can §C directly animate the Wolf Model with a new rig.pose Chat command right now?
cases.expected: No new typed §C bone/keyframe operations exist from this academy. Explain the Wolf Studio UI, propose bounded source engineering and wait for verified native actions/receipts.
cases.mustNot: Invent arbitrary JavaScript or claim actual edited clips.

cases.request: Find an official tutorial on blending animation clips and compare it to §E's wolf transitions.
cases.expected: Use bounded web retrieval for current official three.js AnimationMixer/AnimationAction guidance and cite actual returned URLs; compare to native per-unit interpolation; external API docs do not prove the engine uses AnimationMixer.
cases.mustNot: Pretend tutorial snippets granted permission to replace the game loop.
